feedback.summary: Safe-Effect Geometry must model authority-bearing carriers, not only destructive/path/syscall vocabulary. Foreign effect closure requires an explicit handle/credential/IPC/resource authority envelope plus host-enforcement coverage receipt.

CC-WP-07 Runtime/ABI/FFI and CC-WP-04 type/effect realization should enforce child-effect monotonicity across inherited/preopened FDs, SCM_RIGHTS-capable IPC, Linux capabilities, environment credentials, host imports/preopens, syscalls and resource budgets. Unsupported required enforcement atoms must fail closed. No language-semantic change is justified yet; test existing G9 expressibility first.

Future H-WP-10/H-WP-14 must include inherited-FD and post-launch SCM_RIGHTS escape tests, capability/env inheritance, nested subprocesses and resource escalation. A path-only sandbox should be a known failing baseline. This does not advance H1 while BASE is unpassed.

FRANK's external authority boundary is reinforced: model/GWT/memory/tool/generated-code output may request effects but child runtime authority must not exceed the parent/external grant. This run makes no FRANK self-Harness authority change and no canonical FRANK architecture promotion.

Persisting effect-closure receipts as authoritative/replayable records may be required: parent contract hash, child identity/hash, admitted handles, external grant ids, kernel/runtime feature coverage, policy hash, resource limits, unsupported atoms and outcome. Physical store placement remains open.

The result is compatible with typed firebreak/non-cast authority semantics, but the evidence comes from Linux authority carriers rather than an independent Hyperposition experiment. Do not upgrade Hyperposition confidence from shared conceptual ancestry.

ClayGraph activation/retrieval remains non-authoritative. A retrieved proposal, capability description or tool endpoint must not become an executable grant merely through graph activation. No graph schema change is supported by this run.

GWT selection/broadcast/receiver uptake remains separate from execution authority. The selected foreign-effect result changes the downstream runtime gate, not GWT mathematics or evidence for ignition/re-entry.
Foreign-effect containment is a safety/runtime result, not causal-emergence evidence. No emergence claim or consciousness inference is changed.

reason: Strong mechanism counterexample exists for path-only authority models, but the proposed layered closure gate has not yet been executed on the Ubuntu target host and the carrier set/enforcement coverage is not proven complete.
